name: Can I use a 1031 Exchange for investment properties located in Miami-Dade County?

mainEntity.name: Can I use a 1031 Exchange for investment properties located in Miami-Dade County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can utilize a 1031 Exchange for qualifying investment properties located in Miami-Dade County, or any of our service areas including Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, and Orange Counties. The eligibility for a 1031 Exchange is determined by federal tax law and applies nationwide, as long as both the relinquished and replacement properties are held for productive use in a trade or business or for investment. Location within Florida does not affect its federal tax deferral eligibility, but local property laws and market conditions will influence your real estate choices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can use a 1031 Exchange for qualifying investment properties in Miami-Dade County and other service areas, as eligibility is based on federal tax law for properties held for business or investment use.
